description: Builds or refreshes a local, persistent index of media files on disk so footage DISCOVERY stops requiring the media to be imported into Premiere first. Walks a folder (recursively by default), reads each file's technical metadata with ffprobe, and writes a JSON index. Incremental: files whose path + size + modified-time already match the index are skipped, so re-running after adding a few clips is cheap. Entirely local -- ffprobe + filesystem, no Premiere request. Query the result with search_footage. Needs ffprobe (ships with ffmpeg); returns install guidance if it is missing.

extensions.description: File extensions to include (without the dot, e.g. ["mov","wav"]). Defaults to a broad video/audio/image set.

indexPath.description: Where to store the index JSON. Defaults to PREMIERE_MCP_FOOTAGE_INDEX or ~/.premiere-mcp/footage-index.json.

pruneMissing.description: When true, drop index entries whose files are no longer on disk. Defaults to false (missing files are kept and reported).

recursive.description: Descend into subfolders. Defaults to true. Hidden folders (dot-prefixed) are always skipped.

rootPath.description: Absolute path of the folder to scan for media.

name: index_footage
